title:
Resolves arguments into a single {@link DataPrepTrainValTimeRangesChartSpec} and triggers data request for the
`Reliability.AssetDataPrepTimeRangesTrainValidationChart`dynamic component.

Payload takes the following arguments:

 `dynamicComponentDataSourceId`: The chart dynamic component to trigger a data request for.

 `isInitialRender`: Boolean value to indicate that the action calling this epic is triggered
                    on the initial render. It is used to prepopulate with default values.

 `justRefreshPercentages`: Ensures percentages are updated when switching tabs, avoiding inconsistencies when
                           returning to the time ranges tab. It refreshes percentages based on selected dates
                           without triggering a new data request, covering edge cases.
name: AssetDataPrepTimeRangesTrainValidationChartEpic
